attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter, written in the first person ('I fully believe').

semantics.note: 'Fully believe' plus 'will' is firm, so this is a scorable forecast. The drafter kept the antecedent 'once the hyper scalers flee' and the scope 'some low-fi version'. No deadline was stated.

contract.note: The plain reading is ordinary and fair: broad withdrawal by Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Meta, then a modest form of generative AI still in routine use. The contract correctly requires the withdrawal to happen first. The result here does not depend on any of the flagged ambiguities.

evidence.note: Amazon disclosure from April 2026: AWS remains Anthropic's primary training and cloud provider. This bears on the antecedent (no withdrawal), not on the predicted outcome.
Microsoft announcement from July 2026 expanding AI infrastructure with Mistral. It shows the antecedent has not occurred, so it is context and not outcome evidence.
Amazon pre-earnings review, available 26 Oct 2026, describing continued AI product launches. It shows no withdrawal; it is not evidence about the predicted outcome.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm conditional forecast with no deadline. All three evidence items are company disclosures showing hyperscalers still expanding AI work before the cutoff, so the antecedent (hyperscalers fleeing) has not happened. Under policy, a conditional whose antecedent has not occurred is not scored. The forecast is still open and the packet cannot settle it, so the outcome is unresolved.
